Results.ReviewText: On the upside, it is a quality grill, looks good, lights easily every time and allows very good control over the amount of heat it produces. On the down side, I totally dislike the fuel gage and LP tank mount. First, the mounting system doesn't allow for the curled metal most LP tanks have at the top to act as a handle. If  you rotate the tank to accommodate the mount, the regulator hose assembly is just barely long enough to attach to the gas tank. Second, the fuel gage system is nothing more than a spring system which to me makes the accuracy suspect and is likely to weaken over time. The short regulator hose prevents the addition of an in line pressure gage. My third (and final gripe about the fuel system is that the cutout underneath where the fuel tank sets is so big that the fuel tank drops all the way through to the ground if it is not hung on the fuel gage hook. Were it not for these three things, I would have given a five star review instead of three.
Results.Title: Good Grill, Poor Fuel Gage System.

Results.ReviewText: This was a Birthday present from my my two boys. They always knew that I wanted a Weber gas grill. However, due to the changing times of recent events I had to place my priorities towards the more practical things in life. They always saw me admiring the Weber grills anytime we went to Lowe’s or Home Depot and asked me to just buy one. Honestly deep down I really wanted to but couldn’t afford it. I lost my job and found another job with a lower salary and knee it wasn’t the right time. Then my Birthday was coming up and 18 year old along with my 12 year surprised me with this Absolutely beautiful grill! They both pitched in by using what they saved up. It got me a little choked up up and I have never been so happy. I’ve been using the Weber Spirit for lunches and dinner and truly cooks everything to perfection! I have grilled fall off the bone baby back ribs, melt in your mouth lamb kabobs, zucchini’s and corn, mouthwatering burgers and so much more. My boys tell me everything taste better than dining out! I love my Weber and treat it like a fine car. It’s nickname is “Goriller” the 3rd. Now I’m saving up for the Ultimate Weber Smoker and I’ll tell you all about in the future once I’m able to afford it. Although Weber Grills and products are pricier than most they are absolutely worth every penny! I’ve always had the Weber Kettles but someone broke into our backyard a few years back during Spring Break while we were gone and stole it. That was my 2nd Weber Kettle. The 1st one lasted me 10+ years until the bottom finally rusted out. I only had my 2nd Weber Kettle grill for less than 5-years and it probably still had another 5-7 years! Since then I had to settle for a Cheap inferior brand that rusted out faster than you could sprinkle seasoning on burger patties. Anyhow, my Weber Spirit is smaller than what I wanted but my friends are still envious when I send them post and pictures of the foods it grills to perfection. The design is pleasing, the controls for temperature is spot on and is easy to maintain. Thank you for making such a perfect product. Although I’m just 1 person you definitely have had a fan for life and always will. As a matter of fact 3 of my friends recently purchased their Weber grills too. One of them wanted to make me jealous and picked up the Weber Smoky Mountain and a Weber Summit....just to show off. Whatever, I happy they can afford and very happy and lucky to have my Spirit because I know I’ll be grilling and eating delicious food for many years to come! Thanks again for all your great products. A Weber Fan for life!
Results.Title: My Weber Spirit 310 is the best B-Day gift!

Also the fixed grease pan holder made the task more difficult by being somewhat in the way when trying to hang it.  Other than that the grill cooks like a charm.  It heats up quickly and cooks more evenly than my 14 year old Genesis II which was still working when we got the new one.  I think the burners running front to back rather than side to side contribute to this.  The cooking grated also seem more solid than the ones on my old Genesis.  I just hope the new ignition continues to work as well as the old Genesis, which was still working after 14 years.  Being battery operated the new one doesn’t require more than a light touch to get it started.  The old button required a lot of pressure to get it pushed in, although it almost always lit on the first push.  Overall a great product.

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
